text:
Tomas: who wants a retro-swap tonight? thinking mezz arcade corner + projector for some couch co-op. 7pm start. bring any old cartridges or controllers. :joystick:
Yuki: into it. i've got a SNES pad adapter and a stack of cartridges (Super Metroid, Chrono Trigger).
Bea: i'll bring the JAMMA-to-HDMI converter and a tiny multimeter (projector has been flaky).
Harper: can anyone bring folding chairs? couch seats 3.
Liam: i can bring 2 folding chairs and a travel surge protector. also have a usb-c -> hdmi dongle.
Tomas: perfect. quick poll: 7pm or 8pm? react :one: for 7, :two: for 8.
Yuki: :one: early bird
Bea: :two: need time to finish errands
Harper: :one:
Liam: :two: traffic is ugly today
Tomas: split. ok we'll aim 7:30 as middle ground.
ops-bot: event created: "Mezz Retro Swap" at 2024-03-06T19:30:00Z.
Yuki: small heads-up — last time the projector tripped the breaker when the JAMMA amp spiked. Bea, your converter + multimeter will be clutch.
Bea: yep i'll check power draw and bring a small inline fuse. label it "arcade-fuse" so it doesn't vanish.
Harper: snacks? i can bring really cheap pizza (no anchovies promise). also grape soda. :pizza:
Liam: maybe avoid hot oil snacks near the JAMMA board pls. last time crumbs got in there.
Tomas: agreed. keep food to the table. also, @Yuki can you bring a few spare SNES pads? my childhood ones are brittle.
Yuki: will do. also bringing a small bin for controllers so people don't set them on the floor.
Bea: tiny logistic: if we need to fallback from projector to the big TV, who's ok with swapping quickly? saves time if projector refuses to cooperate.
Liam: i'm fine with TV fallback. just FYI office HDMI cables have a habit of wandering — i'll tape the one we use to the mezz table.
Harper: tagging a couple folks who like retro: @Morgan @Sasha come by if free.
Tomas: quick tech note for anyone recording clips locally: office network blocks outbound streaming. set OBS to local file only.
Yuki: house rule: no public streams of coworkers without consent. if we record, share internally only.
Bea: also, the JAMMA cabinet has a sticky inside the coin slot that needs clearing. i'll bring a tiny screwdriver and some compressed air.
Liam: bringing a roll of gaffer tape for cable tidying. and a small lamp for ambiance (soft light).
Harper: meetup plan: 7:15 setup, 7:30 play. first hour retro rotation, then pick one for co-op.
Tomas: sign-up list: Yuki (SNES stack), Bea (JAMMA + tools), Liam (chairs + cables), Harper (pizza + drinks), Tomas (projector). extras rotate in.
ops-bot: reminder set 30 minutes before event.
Yuki: last ask: if the projector blows a bulb (again), can someone bring spare AAA for the remote? it's always the batteries.
Bea: got AAA. putting them in the arcade kit box.
Harper: see you all 7:30. bringing napkins and hand sanitizer. keep it friendly and low volume after 10pm. :socks:
